Note: Coffee is a good source of niacin, because it is released from the bound form, trigonelline, by roasting. Much of the niacin in maize and part of that in other cereals, including
unfortiﬁed bread, is unavailable for use by the body, being bound in large molecular complexes.
On average, 60 mg tryptophan yields 1 mg NE.
